extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners, respondents in USPTO disciplinary proceedings, OED staff and counsel
extracted.subtask_description: A Final Order under 37 C.F.R. § 11.25 imposing interim suspension of a registered practitioner for conviction of a serious crime, setting procedural steps (limited recognition, referral, answer filing, publication, notices, account dissociation) and related requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grounds for interim suspension (serious crime evidence)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interim suspension may be ordered pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.25 when the suspension is predicated on evidence that the respondent committed a serious crime (here, a felony offense of Conspiracy to Commit Health Care Fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. § 1349).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice and Order requested interim suspension predicated on evidence of a serious crime; the Final Order concluded that interim suspension was appropriate based on that evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guilty plea constitutes a conviction under 37 C.F.R. § 11.1
rubrics_metrics.description: A guilty plea is a conviction pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statutory definition is used to treat the respondent's guilty plea as a conviction supporting disciplinary action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of certain offenses as "serious crimes"
rubrics_metrics.description: Conspiracy to Commit Health Care Fraud is designated a serious crime pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identification of the offense as a 'serious crime' is a predicate for imposing interim suspension under the cited regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity to respond to Notice and Order (40 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Notice and Order provided respondent an opportunity to file, within forty (40) days, a response opposing the imposition of discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a respondent files a timely response, factual disputes may be raised; failure to respond can affect the availability of contested factual issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure to respond creates no genuine issue of material fact
rubrics_metrics.description: In light of respondent's failure to file a response, it is determined there is no genuine issue of material fact under 37 C.F.R. § 11.25.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The absence of a response supports entering interim suspension without a contested factual hearing on the suspension motion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referral of Complaint to hearing officer for formal disciplinary proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: The Complaint is referred, in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.25(b)(5), to a hearing officer for the purpose of conducting a formal disciplinary proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interim suspension is separate from the formal disciplinary proceeding; referral initiates the formal adjudicative phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited recognition to practice for 30 days to facilitate compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent is granted limited recognition to practice before the Office commencing on the date of the Order and expiring thirty (30) days after the date the Order is signed, with such limited recognition being granted for the sole purpose of facilitating Respondent's compliance with the provisions of 37 C.F.R. § 11.58(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited recognition is narrowly tailored and temporary; it exists only to allow the suspended practitioner to comply with suspension-related duties (e.g., client notifications, file transfers) specified in § 11.58.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to file written answer to Complaint within 30 days (37 C.F.R. § 11.36)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.36, within thirty (30) days from the date of the Final Order, Respondent's written answer to the Complaint shall be filed with the hearing officer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order specifies mailing and hand-delivery addresses for filing, requires filing a PDF version via email to the hearing office, and requires serving a copy on the OED Director (with full contact details provided). Compliance with these filing and service instructions is mandatory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of Notice of Interim Suspension in the Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall publish the following Notice in the Official Gazette: (sample notice language describing name, registration number, the interim suspension, and the conviction).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice should state the practitioner's name, registration number, that the individual has been suspended on an interim basis pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.25(b) for having been convicted of the specified offense, and reference the statutory/regulatory authority (35 U.S.C. § 32 and 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.25 and 11.59). It also cites availability of disciplinary decisions at the OED FOIA reading room URL.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice to USPTO employees, other agencies, courts, and state authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall give notice of this Final Order to i) appropriate employees of the USPTO; ii) interested departments, agencies, and courts of the United States; and iii) appropriate authorities of any state in which Respondent is known to be a member of the bar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wide dissemination ensures relevant institutions and state bars are informed of the practitioner's interim suspension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 during suspension
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section 11.58 contains duties of suspended practitioners (e.g., notification and client file transfer obligations); the Order expressly imposes those duties on the suspended practitioner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissociation from USPTO Customer Numbers and electronic accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO shall dissociate Respondent's name from any Customer Number(s) and USPTO verified Electronic System account(s), if any.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order also prohibits the respondent from applying for, obtaining, or being added to a USPTO Customer Number until reinstated to practice before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension not stayed by review
rubrics_metrics.description: If Respondent seeks a review of this suspension, any review shall not operate to postpone or otherwise hold in abeyance the suspension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A request for review does not automatically stay the interim suspension; the suspension remains effective while review is pending.
